entities.summary: Ferran Soriano Compte is a Spanish businessman who is the chief executive officer of Premier League club Manchester City. He also operates in the same role for Major League Soccer's New York City, and the A-League's Melbourne City. Between 2003 and 2008, he was the vice-president and General Manager of Barcelona.
